Details.title: Details
Details.description:
The full file-a-claim payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this:

{"title":"What happened?","policy":{"label":"Auto — 2022 Tesla Model 3","policyNumber":"8842","imageUrl":"/resource/asaInsuranceTeslaModel3"},"incidentTypes":[{"id":"collision","label":"Collision","description":"Accident with another vehicle or object","icon":"collision"},{"id":"theft","label":"Theft or break-in","description":"Vehicle or contents stolen","icon":"theft"},{"id":"weather","label":"Weather or storm","description":"Hail, wind, flood, or fallen tree","icon":"weather"},{"id":"glass","label":"Glass or windshield","description":"Cracked or shattered glass","icon":"glass"}],"submitText":"Start claim"}

Rules:
- 'title' (string, optional): the prompt shown at the top of the card. Defaults to 'What happened?'.
- 'policy' (object, optional but strongly recommended): the policy the claim is filed against. 'label' (string) is the plain-language policy name; 'policyNumber' (string, optional) is shown masked; 'imageUrl' (string, optional) is a photo of the insured item (e.g. the vehicle) shown as a rounded hero image above the policy label. Use a same-origin URL such as a Salesforce static resource ('/resource/<Name>') so it renders in Enhanced Chat v2 without cross-origin issues. Include the policy whenever it is known so the customer sees which policy the claim applies to.
- 'incidentTypes' (array, REQUIRED, at least two objects): the kinds of incident the customer can choose from. Each MUST have 'id' (string, unique, sent back on selection) and 'label' (string, short). Optional: 'description' (string, one short line under the label) and 'icon' (string; one of 'collision','theft','weather','water','fire','glass','liability','medical','other' — drives the tile icon; defaults to 'other'). Choose incident types that fit the policy type (e.g. collision/theft/weather/glass for auto; water/fire/weather/theft/liability for home).
- 'submitText' (string, optional): the confirm-button label; defaults to 'Start claim'.

Never emit fewer than two incident types. Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
